recent_created.description: Take a compiled binary apart and understand it: a beginner's walkthrough of file, nm, objdump and readelf on real x86-64 ELF programs, plus a tested Python CLI that runs the same workflow and resolves the string data a disassembly points at. Written for SNHU CS-410 Module 3, useful for anyone learning to read assembly.
